description: Schema for extracting reinsurance contract fields from parsed markdown.

contract_name.description: The formal title of the reinsurance agreement as it appears in the document header or cover page. Example: 'Property Quota Share Reinsurance Treaty 2024' or 'Facultative Certificate of Reinsurance'.
contract_name.title: Contract Name

contract_number.description: Unique contract, treaty, or certificate number as printed in the document. Examples: 'RT-2024-0012', 'FAC/2024/0091'. Return null if no explicit identifier is stated.
contract_number.title: Contract Number

contract_type.description: Top-level reinsurance form. 'Treaty' covers a portfolio of risks under a single agreement; 'Facultative' covers a single risk. Infer from document type if not stated explicitly.
contract_type.title: Contract Type

contract_sub_type.description: Specific reinsurance structure. 'Quota Share' and 'Surplus' are proportional; 'Excess of Loss' (XOL) and 'Stop Loss' are non-proportional. Return null if not clearly identifiable.
contract_sub_type.title: Contract Sub-Type

contract_nature.description: Whether premiums and losses are shared proportionally (Quota Share, Surplus) or non-proportionally (XOL, Stop Loss). Derive from contract_sub_type if not explicitly stated.
contract_nature.title: Nature of Contract

cedant_name.description: Full legal name of the insurer ceding risk to the reinsurer. Usually introduced as 'between [CEDANT], hereinafter referred to as the Reinsured/Company' at the start of the wording.
cedant_name.title: Cedant Name

reinsurer_name.description: Full legal name of the company assuming risk from the cedant. Often introduced as 'and [REINSURER], hereinafter the Reinsurer'.
reinsurer_name.title: Reinsurer Name

effective_date.description: Date coverage under this contract begins. Normalize to ISO-8601 (YYYY-MM-DD). Return null if only a period ('12 months') is given without an anchor date.
effective_date.title: Effective Date

expiration_date.description: Date coverage under this contract ends. Normalize to ISO-8601 (YYYY-MM-DD).
expiration_date.title: Expiration Date

currency.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for all financial amounts in this contract, e.g. 'USD', 'EUR', 'GBP'. Infer from currency symbols ($, €, £) or context if not stated explicitly.
currency.title: Currency

premium_text.description: Premium as written in the document, preserving phrasing. Examples: '100% of gross net written premium income', '$10,000,000 flat', '25% of GNWPI'. Use this field for descriptive or formulaic premiums that cannot be reduced to a single number.
premium_text.title: Premium (As Written)

premium_amount.description: Premium as a single numeric value in the contract currency, when the document states a flat monetary sum. Example: for '$10,000,000 flat premium' return 10000000. Return null for percentage-based or formulaic premiums.
premium_amount.title: Premium Amount (Numeric)

commission_text.description: Ceding commission as written. Examples: '27.5% ceding commission', 'sliding scale 20%/30%/40%', 'profit commission of 20% after 5% management expense'.
commission_text.title: Ceding Commission (As Written)

commission_rate.description: Ceding commission as a percentage number (not a decimal). Example: for '27.5% ceding commission' return 27.5. Return null for sliding-scale or profit commissions that cannot be reduced to one rate.
commission_rate.title: Commission Rate (%)

retention_text.description: Cedant retention / deductible as written. Examples: '$250,000 each and every loss', '$5M per occurrence', '10% of each risk'.
retention_text.title: Retention (As Written)

retention_amount.description: Retention as a single numeric value in the contract currency when stated as a flat sum. Example: for '$250,000 each and every loss' return 250000. Return null for percentage-based retentions.
retention_amount.title: Retention Amount (Numeric)

limit_text.description: Reinsurer's limit of liability as written. Examples: '$10,000,000 excess of $250,000 each and every loss', '100% quota share up to $5M per risk', 'Aggregate limit $50M'.
limit_text.title: Limit (As Written)

limit_amount.description: Limit as a single numeric value in the contract currency when stated as a flat sum. For '$10,000,000 xs $250,000' return 10000000 (the excess amount, not the sum). Return null for percentage-based limits.
limit_amount.title: Limit Amount (Numeric)

line_of_business.description: Class of business covered. Examples: 'Property', 'Casualty', 'Marine Hull', 'Aviation', 'Cyber', 'Health'. Return the most specific label the document uses.
line_of_business.title: Line of Business

coverage_territory.description: Geographic scope of coverage. Examples: 'Worldwide', 'USA and Canada only', 'Europe excluding UK'.
coverage_territory.title: Coverage Territory

coverage_description.description: Brief prose description of what is covered, including attachment criteria and any notable inclusions. Keep under 500 characters; put detailed legal language in terms_and_conditions.
coverage_description.title: Coverage Description

terms_and_conditions.description: Verbatim or near-verbatim key terms and conditions clauses. Preserve numbering and structure from the source.
terms_and_conditions.title: Terms and Conditions

special_provisions.description: Non-standard clauses, endorsements, exclusions, or special warranties. Examples: 'NMA 2918 Nuclear Exclusion', 'Cyber Exclusion Clause', 'Sunset Clause 36 months'.
special_provisions.title: Special Provisions

title: ReinsuranceContractFieldExtractionSchema
